##### Project general facts

Majestique Residence 2 is a signature five-storey residential building by Credo Investments FZE, thoughtfully created to embody its promise of "Lifestyle Excellence." The building rises with a dedicated ground floor for parking together with four residential floors, each fully dedicated to ultra-luxury designer living. Every home is offered fully furnished in studio, one-, or two-bedroom formats, crafted as a true haven to unwind, relax, and be yourself.

Life at Majestique Residence is elevated by an impressive array of amenities designed for leisure and wellbeing. Residents can soak in incredible skyline views from the stunning rooftop infinity swimming pool, stay active in a state-of-the-art gymnasium fitted with modern equipment, and enjoy dedicated spaces such as a children's playground, restaurants, and retail outlets just steps away. Covered parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance ensure every day here feels effortless, safe, and utterly serene.

Inside, every home reflects redefined luxury through premium interiors and thoughtfully selected furnishings. Bedrooms are dressed with plush double beds, protected mattresses, elegant bedside tables, dressing tables, and sumptuous soft furnishings, while living spaces feature stylish sofa beds, curated dining sets, and fully equipped kitchens complete with an oven, hob, microwave, and all essential cooking utensils. From tasteful curtains and rugs to charming balcony furniture and decorative accents, every detail has been curated to create a warm, sophisticated, move-in-ready sanctuary.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors.

In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings.

Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai.
